# The cmd/vuka test groups: one CI job each (ci.yml's e2e matrix and the
# conformance job), so a failure names the area that broke.
#
# [group] starts a group; each line under it is a regular expression for
# whole top-level test names (anchored: TestLSP.* for a prefix). The rest
# group runs every test no other group names, so a new test runs before it
# is placed. `go run ./.github/scripts/citest check` (run in CI) fails when
# a test is in two groups, a line names no test, or a group has no job.
